techniques.name: 白底黑墨素材滤色显照片
techniques.intent: 用动态墨迹限定照片可见区域，形成白底泼墨边缘。

operations.meaning: white ink background becomes white output; black ink reveals the photo

pitfalls: Screen has opposite visual consequences for black-bottom smoke and white-background ink: white becomes white, not transparency.
Exact ink shape needs a sourced animation; a procedural blob is only an approximation.
A matte smaller than the photo leaves straight uncovered bands.
Changing matte speed is not equivalent to extending a frozen end frame.
UI speeds are rounded; derive from exact source and target spans.
validation: Black matte pixels reveal photo and white matte pixels output white under the chosen screen implementation.
Inspect the full canvas and all edges for uncovered bands.
Check first/middle/end frames show intended ink evolution and target duration.

techniques.name: 加入重叠转场后维持照片拍点
techniques.intent: 使照片更换与音乐提示保持同步，显式补偿转场的时间重叠。

operations.rule: visual event remains at its intended cue

timing.equation: start[i+1]=start[i]+duration[i]-overlap[i]; if next start must equal cue[i+1], duration[i]=cue[i+1]-start[i]+overlap[i]

pitfalls: Adding1.2seconds to all images is specific to the demonstrated overlap behavior, not universal for every editor.
Transition center, start and completed image change are different cue policies.
Any duration change requires checking ink layer intervals again.
Manual lyric onset markers remain unverified without audition.
validation: Recompute all starts after transitions and compare intended events with cue times.
Check total timeline duration from overlaps, not sum of visible UI clip durations.
Audition actual music synchronization and inspect photo/matte boundaries.

techniques.name: 整体氛围与末段重音特效分开定时
techniques.intent: 让装饰特效分别覆盖全片、最后照片及音乐中特殊提示区间。

timing.rule: Effect starts derive from resolved picture boundaries or auditioned music events after transition scheduling.

pitfalls: ASR effect names are uncertain; no exact preset should be inferred from homophones.
Global decoration can reduce face/text visibility and should remain optional.
validation: Inspect each effect onset and final frame for continuity.
Check the central subject remains readable and the intended event timing is preserved.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified; song name, lyric onsets and several optional effect names are not certified.
Exact screen blend working space, ink asset rights and proprietary transition envelope remain unknown.
